name: work-governance
description: Composable governance for goals, planning, delegation, Git, optional code intelligence, validation, long-running project continuity, project truth, archive curation, and reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Composable governance with optional tool adapters.
interface.longDescription: Work Governance helps Codex discover the real goal, use Plans and SubAgents only when valuable, protect Git and authority boundaries, establish optional structural code intelligence safely, keep long-running project development recoverable, promote project truth deliberately, curate completed work before archival, validate proportionally, and report work completely. Core policy modules remain independent of storage and tool choices; optional adapters activate only for matching scenarios.
defaultPrompt: Use $work-governance:work-lifecycle to preserve goal, authority, momentum, and evidence with only the needed modules.
